headline: [Loud Blast!] Houthi Missile Intercepted Over [Riyadh] as Debris Causes Damage
sub: No casualties reported, damage being assessed
caption:
🚨 BREAKING: Houthi Missile Intercepted Over Riyadh as Debris Causes Damage

A missile fired by Yemen's Houthis toward Riyadh was intercepted early on Thursday, November 19, the Saudi-led coalition said. A loud boom was heard across the Saudi capital after a civil defence alert. Falling debris caused material damage, and no casualties were reported.

🔹 Civil defence sent a phone alert at 4:42 a.m. local time and said a few minutes later that the danger had passed.
🔹 The coalition also said it destroyed a Houthi cruise missile aimed at southern Saudi Arabia. The Houthis claimed they targeted Riyadh's King Khalid airport and financial centre; Saudi authorities have not confirmed this.
🔹 Fighting between Saudi Arabia and the Houthis has grown in recent weeks, breaking a 2022 UN-backed truce. The extent of the damage is still being assessed.

💬 Do you think the 2022 truce can be saved? 👇

Sources: Reuters, Arab News

headline: [Peace Declaration!] Trump, Xi and Putin Say Nuclear War [Must Never Be Fought]
sub: Signed after 90 minutes of three-way talks
caption:
🚨 BREAKING: Trump, Xi and Putin Say Nuclear War Must Never Be Fought

US President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin signed a joint "declaration of peace" on Thursday, November 19, after 90 minutes of three-way talks at the APEC summit in Shenzhen, China. In it, the three leaders say: "A nuclear war cannot be won and must never be fought."

🔹 The three countries agreed to hold talks on reducing nuclear risks and stopping the spread of nuclear weapons. The declaration sets no concrete disarmament steps or deadlines.
🔹 It also calls for reform of the United Nations and more supply of refined petroleum products, and says international courts such as the ICC must not abuse their powers.
🔹 The declaration does not mention the wars in Ukraine or Iran. Before the talks, Ukraine's foreign minister warned the meeting would "encourage Putin to continue this war."

💬 Can a declaration like this make the world safer? 👇

Sources: Reuters, dpa

#GlobalEye #Trump #XiJinping #Putin #APEC #NuclearWeapons
photo_needed: Trump, Xi Jinping and Putin together at the APEC summit in Shenzhen (all faces clearly visible), or any two of them shaking hands there. A big, clear, landscape photo works best.
